simple: Check Point External Risk Management (formerly Cyberint) — part of Check Point Exposure Management: an agentless cloud service that looks for threats outside the perimeter. Finds all the company’s internet-facing resources (domains, subdomains, IPs, cloud resources) and their vulnerabilities and misconfigurations with a risk score; looks for lookalike domains, phishing sites and brand abuse; monitors leaked credentials and account takeover; provides news, ransomware watch, Check Point Research reports and indicator-of-compromise searches. Licensed by number of external assets; “coins” pay for takedowns of fraudulent resources and investigations. Also: fake social media accounts and mobile apps impersonating the brand and executives; collection and search across open, deep and dark web sources — forums, closed chats, marketplaces, TOR sites; leak and fraud detection (cards, emails, source code); a knowledgebase on threat groups, malware and CVEs with techniques (TTPs) and indicators; supply chain intelligence — discovers your vendors on its own and monitors their risks and incidents. Daily scanning, 3 users, 3 monitored vendors. No managed analyst service.
